mathematical_comparison: F25 asks for sufficient conditions for equality. The full-row-rank upper-bound theorem in F86 concerns the opposite side of the desired equality and does not cover our rank-deficient monomial bases. F89 gives lift-versus-base quantum distance bounds with parity/dimension premises, not quantum-versus-classical equality for the present family. F87 and F88 supply methods and formalization background.
classical_predecessor: Kelley et al. ISIT2004, TheoremIII.1 and following note; complete one-page primary PDF read and rendered. Existing source ID now linked to bibliography F90. Projected-support stopping is classical; binary cancellation/doubled-fiber argument is proved explicitly in our artifact.
